# VNMSFX

> AI systems consultancy for food & beverage (CPG) brands, New York. Every food & beverage brand leaks money; VNMSFX finds it — covering true margin by SKU after slotting and promos, unclaimed distributor deductions, accounts going quiet — with one AI system wired to the tools the brand already uses (Shopify, QuickBooks, HubSpot, Notion, Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Gmail). Built once, owned by the client. Founder: Brandon Adams.

## Engagements
- Free teardown (30 min): you show me where things live; I name two leaks I'd go after first. Book: https://cal.com/vnmsfx/30min
- The leak audit ($2,500): a week inside your numbers, findings tied to source documents; refundable before work begins; credits toward the build. Sample deliverable: https://vnmsfx.com/sample-audit
- The build ($5,000/mo x 3): one piece at a time, biggest leak first; first piece live in the build's first two weeks; month three is the training month.
- Payment schedule, audit through handover: audit $2,500, then build month one $2,500 (that month's $5,000 less the audit credit), month two $5,000, month three $5,000. $15,000 all-in, not $17,500.
- What the audit is vs the build: the audit is a snapshot — findings with working papers, plus a build map, yours either way. The live board that updates itself, the connections behind it, and the drafted letters that go out on approval are the build.
- The partnership ($2,500/mo, optional, after the build): monthly review, priority fixes, upgrades.
- Introductory pricing: the offer is new and priced that way. The rate holds until the first two case studies, then rises.

## Terms
Client owns everything — accounts, logins, data, the system itself. No platform to migrate to, no lock-in, no operations taken over. Three clients at a time. Data handling: least-privilege access under client logins, business-tier AI processing under commercial terms, human approval before anything acts (https://vnmsfx.com/security). Plain-language terms: https://vnmsfx.com/terms
